name: Spore-Mother

Traits.name: Cadaver Verdure
Traits.text: When a creature the spore-mother can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the spore-mother seeds the corpse; it rises as a fungal thrall under her command at the start of her next turn.
Traits.clause: takes over the bodies of the things she kills

Traits.name: Word of Command
Traits.text: When a creature the spore-mother can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the spore-mother speaks a word of rot; each fungal thrall that can hear her within 60 feet can immediately move or make one attack as a reaction to her command.
Traits.clause: When a creature the spore-mother can see is reduced to 0 hit points, the spore-mother can speak a word of rot that reson

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the spore-mother, the spore-mother and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the spore-mother doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The spore-mother makes three attacks, using Spore Limb or Cadaver Seed in any combination.

Actions.name: Spore Limb
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Cadaver Seed
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 28 (5d8 + 6) Poison damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Cadaverspore Hex
Bonus Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* Until the start of the spore-mother's next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the spore-mother.
Bonus Actions.gmQuote: takes over the bodies of the things she kills and sends them at you

lore: Born of a rotting grove where the fallen were never buried, the spore-mother drifts between battlefields and mass graves, seeding cadaver-fungus into any corpse that has not yet cooled, so that she may build a family of the dead and march it home.
